INSERT INTO job_seeker_profile ( member_id, profile_image_url, residence_region, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, remote_preferred, flexible_preferred, hybrid_preferred, onsite_preferred, contact_time_start, contact_time_end, contact_method, introduction, profile_public )
VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{residenceRegion}, #{desiredJob}, #{desiredRegion}, #{employmentType}, #{careerType}, #{careerYears}, #{minSalary}, #{remotePreferred}, #{flexiblePreferred}, #{hybridPreferred}, #{onsitePreferred}, #{contactTimeStart}, #{contactTimeEnd}, #{contactMethod}, #{introduction}, #{profilePublic} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
m.id AS memberId, m.name, m.birth_date AS birthDate, m.gender, m.email, m.phone,
p.id AS profileId, p.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.residence_region AS residenceRegion, p.desired_job AS desiredJob, p.desired_region AS desiredRegion, p.employment_type AS employmentType, p.career_type AS careerType, p.career_years AS careerYears, p.min_salary AS minSalary, p.remote_preferred AS remotePreferred, p.flexible_preferred AS flexiblePreferred, p.hybrid_preferred AS hybridPreferred, p.onsite_preferred AS onsitePreferred, p.contact_time_start AS contactTimeStart, p.contact_time_end AS contactTimeEnd, p.contact_method AS contactMethod, p.introduction, p.profile_public AS profilePublic, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN job_seeker_profile p ON m.id = p.member_id
WHERE m.id = #{memberId}
